facts.fact: The Statistics from Space project, with Universidade Eduardo Mondlane, IFPRI and the University of Twente among the authors' affiliations, tested an Earth-observation crop-type mapping workflow in Mozambique and generated openly accessible crop type maps and statistics for Gaza, Manica and Zambezia for the 2024/25 season.

systems.platform: EO-based sampling frame, smartphone field-data app, cloud aggregation and visualization platform
systems.owner: University of Twente, Universidade Eduardo Mondlane, IFPRI (CGIAR)
